scope: One stable installed-program entry, owned legacy-entry migration, safe obsolete program cleanup and safe uninstall.
cause: Prior installers wrote HKCU Uninstall/TunnelStudio-<version> and retained every version directory.
registry_testing: Actual registry policy and rollback logic with typed, case-insensitive fake HKCU; explicit native adapter flags checked. No native Windows registry execution.
filesystem_testing: Actual temporary files, manifests, hashes, version directories, activation, deletion and process locks; survey sentinels compared byte for byte.
startup_testing: Retained real-process 21 MB hidden-recovery startup regression plus staged/extracted full component command gates.
upgrade_transaction: NSIS writes new uninstaller into staging before activation.
Payload hash verification and isolated actual application startup check precede all release/registry mutation.
Workspace process lock covers activation, registration and old-program cleanup.
Stable entry and CurrentInstall publish/readback together; failures restore typed registry state, marker bytes and directories.
Owned version-specific entries retire only after new stable registration succeeds.
Keep current and exact prior active release; same-version reinstall remaps prior to its renamed backup.
Ambiguous prior state preserves older folders; postcommit cleanup errors are warnings and do not claim failed activation.
file_cleanup: Canonical current-user program releases tree only; matching manifest/version/publisher anchors required.
Delete only unchanged manifest-listed regular program files; verify path components, hashes and file identity.
Preserve configured survey workspace, source/cache formats, all unlisted and modified files.
Manifest-owned unchanged numpy arrays under runtime are library resources and can be removed.
No symlink/junction/reparse traversal and no recursive deletion of installed release folders.
Ownership anchors and unverified generated files may remain; removed_bytes means logical sizes, not guaranteed physical free space.
uninstall: Same workspace lock and path/data-overlap checks protect removal.
Pending owned-file deletion retains registry/uninstaller/manifest for retry.
An old or backup uninstaller cannot remove current registration, marker or shared shortcuts.
Only an exact verified generated receipt permits final uninstaller/anchor removal.
runtime_baseline: 0.17.3; all 20,001 functional runtime files remain byte-identical.
retained_application_evidence: 0.18.3 validation: 331 application tests, browser and geometry/mesh/alignment/registration evidence. 0.18.4 installer startup correction retained. No new survey algorithm accuracy claim.
